title: The Blaschka Object Network — Open Rakow Business-Book Corpus Register
scope: Blaschka business and order books identified by the Corning Museum of Glass as downloadable PDF primary sources and usable as a corpus for original customers, sales, dealers and transaction chronology. Public digital surrogates remain the archival authority; project OCR is a derivative search layer.

records.title: Notizbüchel für 1869–1870
records.repository: Juliette K. and Leonard S. Rakow Research Library, Corning Museum of Glass
records.access: downloadable PDF identified by Corning Museum of Glass
records.evidence: Corning's 2016 global-census account states that original European collections were reconstructed in part from this order book and Geschäfts-Anmerkungen and explicitly says both are downloadable as PDFs.

records.title: Geschäfts-Anmerkungen
records.repository: Juliette K. and Leonard S. Rakow Research Library, Corning Museum of Glass
records.access: downloadable PDF identified by Corning Museum of Glass
research_use: comparison of Ward, Damon, Frič and direct institutional purchasing
records.evidence: Corning's 2016 global-census account explicitly identifies Geschäfts-Anmerkungen as one of the downloadable order/business books used to reconstruct original collections. J. P. Short independently locates the Jahres-Rechnung 1872 and Geschäfts-Uebersicht 1873 inside this volume at Box 23, Folder 64.

method_guard: Treat page images/PDFs as primary-source witnesses. Local OCR may be used to search and align entries but must preserve page identity, raw transcription and uncertainty. Do not infer a current collection from a historical customer entry; order-book customer and present holder are separate entities.

corpus_strategy.unit: page / dated account or order entry
